name: create_customer
description: This tool will create a customer in Stripe.

name: list_customers
description: This tool will fetch a list of Customers from Stripe.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100.

email.description: A case-sensitive filter on the list based on the customer's email field.

name: create_product
description: This tool will create a product in Stripe.

name: list_products
description: This tool will fetch a list of Products from Stripe.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned.

name: create_price
description: This tool will create a price in Stripe. If a product has not already been specified, a product should be created first.

product.description: The ID of the product to create the price for.

unit_amount.description: The unit amount of the price in cents.

name: list_prices
description: This tool will fetch a list of Prices from Stripe.

product.description: The ID of the product to list prices for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned.

name: create_payment_link
description: This tool will create a payment link in Stripe.

price.description: The ID of the price to create the payment link for.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product to include.

name: create_invoice
description: This tool will create an invoice in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to create the invoice for.

days_until_due.description: The number of days until the invoice is due.

name: list_invoices
description: This tool will fetch a list of Invoices from Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list invoices for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned.

name: create_invoice_item
description: This tool will create an invoice item in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to create the invoice item for.

price.description: The ID of the price for the item.

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to create the item for.

name: finalize_invoice
description: This tool will finalize an invoice in Stripe.

invoice.description: The ID of the invoice to finalize.

name: retrieve_balance
description: This tool will retrieve the balance from Stripe. It takes no input.

name: create_refund
description: This tool will refund a payment intent in Stripe.

payment_intent.description: The ID of the PaymentIntent to refund.

amount.description: The amount to refund in cents.

name: list_payment_intents
description: This tool will list payment intents in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list payment intents for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned.

name: list_subscriptions
description: This tool will list all subscriptions in Stripe.

customer.description: The ID of the customer to list subscriptions for.

price.description: The ID of the price to list subscriptions for.

status.description: The status of the subscriptions to retrieve.

name: cancel_subscription
description: This tool will cancel a subscription in Stripe.

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription to cancel.

name: update_subscription
description: This tool will update an existing subscription in Stripe, for example to change the price or quantity.

subscription.description: The ID of the subscription to update.

items.description: A list of subscription items to update, add, or remove.

name: list_coupons
description: This tool will fetch a list of Coupons from Stripe.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned.

name: create_coupon
description: This tool will create a coupon in Stripe.

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts.

percent_off.description: A positive float larger than 0, and smaller or equal to 100, that represents the discount the coupon will apply.

duration.description: How long the discount will last: once, repeating, or forever.

name: list_disputes
description: This tool will fetch a list of disputes in Stripe.

charge.description: Only return disputes associated to the charge specified by this charge ID.

payment_intent.description: Only return disputes associated to the PaymentIntent specified by this PaymentIntent ID.

name: search_stripe_documentation
description: Search and retrieve relevant Stripe documentation to answer integration questions.

question.description: The user question about integrating with Stripe.

language.description: The programming language to search for in the docs.
